newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Kegalle's debentures listed in Colombo.
newsitem.headline: Kegalle's debentures listed in Colombo.

text.p: The Colombo Stock Exchange said in a statement that it has allowed trading in debentures of Kegalle Plantations Ltd from Tuesday.
Kegalle Plantations, one of six privatised estate firms listed in Colombo, issued five million convertible unsecured 10-rupee debentures with a coupon rate of six percent a year ago.
The entire issue was taken up by RPK Management Co Ltd which also holds 51 percent of Kegalle Plantations' 200 million rupees equity, the company said.
RPK Management is a joint venture between John Keells Holdings Ltd and Richard Pieris & Co Ltd.
The other debentures listed in Colombo are those issued by Overseas Realty (Ceylon) Ltd, Central Industries Ltd and Vanik Incorporation Ltd.
